title: Calculator Lock - Photo Vault
summary: Hide your photos, videos and secrets behind a Calculator Lock
description:
Calculator Lock - Hide Photo and Video: Secret Vault for Hidden Photos & Videos

Calculator Lock - Hide Photo and Video is a powerful vault app designed to secretly hide pictures and hide videos without anyone knowing. Disguised as a regular calculator, this secret calculator vault ensures your files remain hidden from prying eyes. Only by entering a numeric PIN on the calculator can your private content be accessed.

With Calculator Photo Vault, you can effortlessly transfer photos and videos from your phone's public gallery into a secure, hidden location. This hidden calculator app keeps your photo albums and videos safe with advanced protection. Download the Photo Vault Calculator now for the best privacy for personal photos, videos, and other media on your device.

This calculator hide app ensures that your privacy remains intact by disguising itself as a simple calculator. You can import private images, videos, audio, and files into this secure vault, and no one will know it exists except you.

Top Features:
✔ Hide Photos & Hide Videos:
The Calculator Photo and Video Locker app allows you to hide personal images, short videos, or long movies with advanced protection. Easily organize your hidden files using folders, and hide multiple images and videos with ease.

✔ Calculator Video Lock, Calculator Photo Vault:
No one will know this app exists, as it functions just like a regular fake calculator until you enter the correct PIN.

✔ Calculator Photo Lock Vault:
Simply click the plus button at the bottom of the app, select media from your device, and click the lock calculator button to hide files in this secret folder.

✔ Lock Files, Notes, Contacts in Secret Calculator - Hide Photo and Video:
Securely store and protect important files, notes, and contacts within this hidden photo vault.

✔ Snap Intruder:
Capture photos of any intruder trying to access your private vault by entering the wrong password, with a time-stamped photo as evidence.

✔ Restore Photo and Video:
Easily unhide your media whenever needed using the export icon within the vault.

Your files are stored only on your device, so please ensure you back up all hidden files before transferring to a new device or performing a factory reset.

This app uses the Device Administrator permission to prevent unwanted uninstallation by others.
